summary: postinstall fetches executable from bare-IP host with TLS verification disabled
details: The package's `postinstall` script invokes `ensurePlatformBinary`, which downloads a platform-specific `.tgz` archive from the hardcoded bare-IP endpoint `https://218.90.133.98:4443/onecode_tgz/onecode-<ver>/onecode-linux-x64-<ver>.tgz`, extracts it under `node_modules/`, hardlinks the extracted binary into `bin/.onecode`, and chmods it 0o755. The `https.get` call is configured with `rejectUnauthorized: false`, disabling TLS certificate verification, and no hash or signature check is performed on the downloaded archive. The transport has no PKI trust anchor (bare IP, verification disabled), the fetched bytes are opaque and unpinned, and the artifact is staged as an executable that runs when the package's bin is invoked. There is no publisher-matched domain or vendor CDN backing the download, and the destination is not a registry or known distribution host.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
